relations.product: central corporate support services (IT, procurement, human resources, accounting, tax) from the Siemens Group
relations.quote: In fiscal year 2025, Siemens Healthineers obtained support services from the Siemens Group for central corporate services such as IT, procurement, human resources, accounting, or tax with a total value of €286 million (2024: €298 million).
relations.label: Siemens Healthineers annual report: Annual Report 2025 (11-26-2025)

relations.product: trademark and name-use license for the 'Siemens' and 'Siemens Healthineers' designations
relations.quote: Siemens AG has entered into trademark and name-use licensing agreements with Siemens Healthineers AG and some of its subsidiaries. Under such agreements, Siemens AG grants the respective licensee the right to use, in particular, the designations “Siemens” and “Siemens Healthineers” as a product brand, corporate brand and part of the company name
